title: Katieann Vogel on Unblocking Yourself, Finding Fulfillment & Creating Art with Kahran
summary: Kahran talks with ocean poet Katieann Vogel about her winding path — outdoor adventure guide, professional limerick-writer, now poet — and what it means to spend a life in nature. They get into the artist's identity, using your obsessions as art projects (rather than letting them spin endlessly in your life), the morality of consistency, and how mood and tone of a conversation carry more than the words.

intents.display: to hear a poet talk about the winding path to becoming an artist
to think about treating obsessions as art projects instead of identity loops
